previous_statement: Uniform near-isometry. For K_N=1+2*C_nest and a universal threshold, every n and x in M_n tensor B satisfy ||T_n(x)-v_n(x)||<=2*C_nest*t*||x|| and (1-K_N*t)||x||<=||T_n(x)||<=(1+K_N*t)||x||.
new_statement: Uniform near-isometry. By the exact formula in node 1.2 and the forward estimate of lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison specialized as in node 1.1.1, ||T_n(x)-v_n(x)||=||W_n(v_n(x))-v_n(x)||<=C_nest*t*||v_n(x)||. Def-extended-delta-inclusion gives ||v_n(x)||<=(1+t)||x||, so for t<=1 this is at most 2*C_nest*t*||x||. Combining this with (1-t)||x||<=||v_n(x)||<=(1+t)||x|| by the triangle and reverse-triangle inequalities gives (1-K_N*t)||x||<=||T_n(x)||<=(1+K_N*t)||x|| with K_N=1+2*C_nest, uniformly in n.
